readerCopy.body: A sudden change can touch an old vulnerability before anyone has had time to decide if the disruption is actually dangerous now. When Uranus conjoins Chiron, change and sensitivity fuse, making a new technology, schedule, move, role, or break in routine resemble an earlier experience of being unprepared or exposed. The old reaction can arrive faster than the current evidence. The surprise becomes easier to use once what truly needs protection is separated from what merely feels familiar to the old wound.
